_note: Shared base rules that style a phone control without a phone scope. Each is a default or hidden-on-desktop rule that the phone overrides under body.ed-phone / body.touch. Add a reason for every entry.

selectors..fpTop button: The Leave first person button is on desktop too; the phone sizes it under body.touch.
selectors..fpTop: The Leave first person bar is on desktop too; the phone moves it under body.touch.
selectors.#fpStick::after: The stick's touch margin is part of the shared first-person markup; body:not(.touch) hides the stick on desktop and the phone resizes it under body.touch.
selectors.#fpLook: The look pad is shared markup, hidden on desktop by body:not(.touch); the phone resizes it under body.touch.
selectors.#fpStick: The stick is shared markup, hidden on desktop by body:not(.touch); the phone places it under body.touch.
selectors.#fpKnob: The stick knob is shared markup, hidden with the stick on desktop.
selectors..fpBtns: The touch button group is hidden on desktop by body:not(.touch); the phone lays it out under body.touch.
selectors..fpBtns button: The touch buttons are hidden on desktop by body:not(.touch); the phone lays them out under body.touch.
